CAMPAIGN EXPLANATION Our debut campaign, ‘I’m Sure You Know Them Too,’ invites people to rethink how they form social connections. Are they truly building new relationships, or simply uncovering ties that have always existed? It celebrates those serendipitous moments—whether during a night out with friends, a sports activity, or a casual game—when a conversation with someone new reveals they’re not a stranger after all. The realization hits: “ You lived there? You were there? Wait, you know them too?” and leaves you thinking how you hadn’t met them sooner. Our brand signature, the red band across the eyes, symbolizes that the people you’re meant to know are already within your extended social circle. PADEL GAME MEET-UP Music: "7h du matin" by Jacqueline Taieb plays over morning city sounds. Scene: The video opens with an alarm ringing at 7 am. Phil, just waking up in his London flat, shuts off his alarm, stretches, and quickly goes through his morning routine. He has his cup of coffee at home. The camera briefly shows him reading a newspaper, which subtly displays the "we b0nd" logo in the corner. We see a quick- cut sequence: brushing teeth, throwing on his padel outfit, and hopping onto a Lime bike. Journey: The camera follows Phil biking through quiet London streets—past closed cafes and just-opening markets—until he reaches a padel court. A friend-of-a-friend, his new "we b0nd" connection, is waiting. Connection: They greet with a friendly “first-time” handshake, then move to the court. The vibe is energetic as they warm up, exchange a few lighthearted laughs, and finally smash the game together. As they play, close- ups show branded padel balls bouncing across the court. Alternate Scene: A similar intro, featuring two guys and two girls getting ready to meet, showing each perspective as they head to the court. 2 5moodboard VIDEO CAMPAIGNS www.web0nd.com 2. DRINKS AT A HIDDEN BAR Music: "I Wanna Dance with Somebody" by Whitney Houston plays in the background, setting a lively mood. Scene: The video opens with a steamy bathroom scene, where the lead character, a young woman, is stepping out of a hot shower dancing to the music. The camera follows her as she gets ready, applying nail polish, adjusting her earrings, and selecting an outfit. She is seen adding finishing touches like a hair-clip featuring the "we b0nd" logo. Journey: A quick transition shows her hopping into a classic London black cab (or a bright yellow NYC cab, depending on the city), where she looks out the window at the city lights. Arrival: She arrives at an understated, hidden bar. Neon lights spill onto the pavement as she walks inside, greeting her "we b0nd" connection at the door with an excited smile and warm embrace, leading to the bar for a celebratory first round. Video cuts as her cocktail arrives with an ice cube bearing the "we b0nd" logo. 2 6CHAPTER 2 VIDEO CAMPAIGNS www.web0nd.com 3. BEACH BACKGAMMON Music: “ La Madrague” by Brigitte Bardot Setting: Warm beach scenery in Miami or the South of France, with gentle waves and relaxed vibes. Scene: Alex is already at the beach, his backgammon set laid out on a beach blanket, with the sun filtering through palm trees. Arrival: His new "we b0nd" connection shows up, casually dressed and excited for a friendly game. Game Play: The camera zooms in on the backgammon board, showing custom pieces with the "we b0nd" logo as they move their pieces, chatting and sharing laughs. A brief shot of a beach bag with the logo. Vibe: The scene is easy- going and playful, with close- ups of game pieces, sand slipping through fingers, and refreshing beach drinks on the side. 2 7CHAPTER 3
